Examples.Title: Deletes an Agent.
Examples.Code:
### Deletes an Agent.
# @name DeleteAgent
DELETE {{host}}/v1beta/agents/{{agentsId}}
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# default
# Description: Successful operation
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Gets a specific Agent.
Examples.Code:
### Gets a specific Agent.
# @name GetAgent
GET {{host}}/v1beta/agents/{{agentsId}}
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# default
# Description: Successful operation
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Lists all Agents.
Examples.Code:
using var client = new GeminiNextGenClient(apiKey);
var response = await client.Agents.ListAsync();
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Google.Gemini.NextGen;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title:
Cancels an interaction by id. This only applies to background interactions
that are still running.
Examples.Description:
Cancels an interaction by id. This only applies to background interactions
that are still running.
Examples.Code:
### Cancels an interaction by id. This only applies to background interactions
that are still running.
# @name cancelInteractionById
POST {{host}}/v1beta/interactions/{{interactionsId}}/cancel
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful operation
# Content-Type: application/json
# 4XX
# Description: Client Error
# Content-Type: application/json
# 5XX
# Description: Server Error
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Creates a new interaction.

Retrieves the full details of a single interaction based on its
`Interaction.id`.
Examples.Description:
Retrieves the full details of a single interaction based on its
`Interaction.id`.
Examples.Code:
### Retrieves the full details of a single interaction based on its
`Interaction.id`.
# @name getInteractionById
GET {{host}}/v1beta/interactions/{{interactionsId}}?include_input={{include_input}}&last_event_id={{last_event_id}}&stream={{stream}}
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful retrieval of the interaction.
# Content-Type: application/json, text/event-stream
# 4XX
# Description: Client Error
# Content-Type: application/json
# 5XX
# Description: Server Error
# Content-Type: application/json
